Before You Film

Six little things to get right

Have this open, or a quick read beforehand, whatever works for you. It's not a test, it just means fewer re-films.

🍑
Seat tucked securely under baby's bottomThe M shape for babies, snug under the bottom for every size.
🤲
One hand on baby, every single frameNot most of the video. All of it.
🔒
Buckle clicked, safety loop in useClosed properly over the clip, loop threaded through.
😗
Baby close enough to kiss, face visibleHigh on your chest, face in view the whole time.
📱
Vertical 9:16, key text in the safe zone1080×1920 or better. Nothing important in the top or bottom strip.
✨
No watermarks, anywhereExport clean and send the original file, not a re-download.
Keep the full checklist handy while you film 📎 Scan for the interactive version, with photos and a tick-box for each one. bamborachecklist.netlify.app
